department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 p.m.; incomplete applications may not be reviewed.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional (the catalog calls it recommended); submit it only if it shows math ability not visible in your record.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for our Ph.D. program.

also.quote: The GRE General Test is recommended.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT section minimums (new scale): Reading 4, Writing 4, Listening 3.5, Speaking 4; MyBest scores not accepted.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum iBT TOEFL score of reading (4 or higher), writing (4 or higher), listening (3.5 or higher), and speaking (4 or higher). Materials science and engineering does not accept the “My Best” iBT TOEFL score.

ielts_min.quote: The IELTS Academic exam requires a minimum overall band score of 7.0 or higher.

supervisor.value: Admitted students match with an advisor after arriving at Cornell, not before.
supervisor.quote: If offered admission, Cornell Materials Science and Engineering graduate matriculates will match with an advisor during their time at Cornell, not before.

funding.value: PhD students are fully funded through TA and/or GRA appointments for the guaranteed period in the admission letter.
funding.quote: Though fully funded through Teaching Assistant and/or Graduate Research Assistant appointments

also.quote: Generally funded as a Graduate Research Assistant for the remainder of the guaranteed funding (as detailed in admission letters).

entry_route.value: An undergraduate degree in engineering or physical science is expected.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have an undergraduate degree in engineering or physical science.
